format: Certificate (Q, bound), problem s3_C5: J-free 3-graphs, J = 123 234 345 145 125 (1-based triples): H contains no copy of J as a (not necessarily induced) subgraph.  Objective: f(H) = F(H)/210, F(H) = 210 - sum over the 35 4-subsets Q of [7] of C(e_H(Q), 2) (cosig3; sigma_n = 1 - f in BCL's x != y form); the certificate proves sigma(J) <= 1 - bound.  Graphs on [7] are 35-bit masks, bit i = the i-th 3-subset of [7] in colex order (sorted by largest element, then the next).  For every key k: Q_k = A_k^T A_k / M^2 with A_k = cert.npz['A<k>'] (integer rows), M = 2^18; rows and columns of Q_k are indexed by keys[k]['flags'] in the listed order.  A flag of key k = (s, m, sigma) is an admissible 3-graph on [m] (mask over the 3-subsets of [m] in colex order) whose restriction to [s] is sigma (the type: canonical labelled mask on [s] = minimum over all permutations of [s]); it is listed in canonical form = the minimum mask over all permutations of [m] fixing 0..s-1 pointwise, flags in increasing order.  M_k(H)[F1, F2] = #{(theta, U1, U2): theta an injective map [s] -> [7] with H[theta] (theta_i -> i) = sigma exactly, U1, U2 disjoint (m - s)-subsets of [7] - theta (ordered pair), the flag of theta + U1 is F1 and that of theta + U2 is F2} / (number of configurations of (s, m)).  slack(H) = f(H) - sum_k <Q_k, M_k(H)>; the certificate states slack(H) >= bound for every admissible H on [7] (two exhaustive exact scans in cert.json), hence the bound by the plain flag-algebra argument (Q_k PSD).  Engine evaluation: Z(H) = sum_terms wint Qsum, Qsum_k = sum over Aut(sigma_k) of the relabelled Gram A_k^T A_k, <Q, M(H)> = Z(H)/(5040 M^2); cert.json groups = [F, max Z over the graphs with this F, an argmax graph, count].
